title: Reproducibility manifest
description: CONTRACTS HĐ-13. Acceptance criterion: hand this file to somebody else and they rebuild the same Decision Card, differing only in wall-clock time. Every field below exists because leaving it out breaks exactly that — including `bootstrap`, without which the confidence interval cannot be reproduced at all.

git_sha.description: The code that produced the card. Lower-case hex so a rebuilt manifest cannot differ by letter case alone.

docker_image_digest.description: Null when the run was not containerised. HĐ-7.4 requires the same image for every candidate in one comparison; recording it is how that is checkable afterwards.

anchor_config_version.description: Mandatory (HĐ-8.3 law 3): a recommendation computed under unknown anchors cannot be rebuilt.

episode_context_ids.description: The exact conditions, not just how many. HĐ-3.2 requires every candidate to have run the same set, and only the ids prove it.

bootstrap.description: Added at 2.2.0. The CI on the card comes from a random resample; without the seed two people running this manifest get two intervals, and that difference is not wall-clock time.

benchmark_host.description: HĐ-7.4: same machine, same allocation, same thread count for every candidate — otherwise even the relative comparison is meaningless.

created_at.description: ISO-8601. The one field a rebuild is allowed to differ on.
